mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 10% MoM signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST drop > 10% MoM does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rise > 2% MoM does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS rise > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS drop > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.
